Colocalization Explorer

Filter by locus and dataset family. Bubble size = PP.H4; color = significant (PP.H4 > 0.8).

Tip: start typing the name of a locus (ex. BIN1, KAT8) — the plot is only legible with 1 to 3 loci selected.
